title: Reconstruction of a Unilateral Alveolar Cleft Using a Customized Allogenic Bone Block and Subsequent Dental Implant Placement in an Adult Patient
authors: Blume O, Back M, Born T, Donkiewicz P . J Oral Maxillofac Surg. 2019;77(10):2127.e1-2127.e11. doi:10.1016/j.joms.2019.05.021
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxgraft bonebuilder (processed human allograft) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “regarding the performance of allogenic bone blocks in orofacial cleft osteoplasty” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
